result.text: It worked roughly 99% of the time. I lost interest in other women, with one exception: an extremely beautiful girl who caught my attention once. That surprised me. B., however, never fully believed the switch was real. She even began hallucinating that I was looking at or talking to other women when I wasn't. Her jealousy, then, was not simply tracking what I was doing in the present. It was more likely insecure attachment from her childhood trying to justify its continued existence.
